title: Exactness of extension by zero
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow\overline X$ be
an open immersion [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] of schemes and use
the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] with the
constant coefficient sheaf $A$, including the finite-torsion coefficient
rings [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] $A_{E,n}$. Then the
extension-by-zero functor [def-weil-extension-by-zero] $j_!$ is exact.

proof.text: Unfold the intrinsic extension-by-zero functor [def-weil-extension-by-zero] as the inverse canonical coefficient realization, fixed-coefficient open-immersion lower shriek, and ambient canonical coefficient realization. The exact canonical realization equivalence [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] is additive. Its inverse is additive by Mathlib Equivalence.inverse_additive, and both directions of an equivalence preserve finite limits and finite colimits.

Apply the existing fixed-coefficient theorem [lem-sfb-finite-extension-by-zero-exact] with coefficient category ModuleCat (ULift A). Its additive instance and finite-limit-preserving instance give the first two properties of the middle functor. The existing lower-shriek adjunction makes it a left adjoint, so it preserves finite colimits. The additive and finite-limit/finite-colimit composition instances now prove all three assertions for the defining composite.
